name: m5_custom_chat_responses_stream
config:
[server]
auth_mode = "none"
allow_dynamic_routes = false

[retry]
max_attempts = 1

[providers.respup]
dialect = "openai-responses"
base_url = "{UPSTREAM}/v1"
api_key = "resp-secret"

[[models]]
name = "bridge-chat"
provider = "respup"
model = "gpt-4.1"
